one_line_description.value: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform that empowers brands and retailers to grow at all stages of development, across every sales channel.
one_line_description.quote: A NASDAQ-listed, publicly traded company, we empower brands and retailers to grow at all stages of their development, across every sales channel.

has_public_api.quote: BigCommerce has several APIs that let you manage store data, authenticate customers, make client-side queries for product information, and more.

api_type.quote: Server-side REST APIs for managing store data and operations.

api_breadth.value: REST (Admin and Storefront) plus GraphQL Account/Admin/Storefront APIs; Admin REST spans catalog, content, orders, customers, shipping, inventory, payments and webhooks; read-write operations.
api_breadth.quote: - Management — Orders, Customers, Shipping, Store Information, Store Logs, Channels, Sites, Segments, Tax, Inventory, Locations, Pickup

docs_url.quote: Whether you’re creating a storefront, building an app, or managing store data through APIs, these docs will get you there.

auth_methods.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: It also contains a reference for available OAuth scopes and provides a compelling list of reasons to migrate from legacy API tokens to OAuth credentials.

access_model.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data. Navigate to Settings > API Accounts in your store control panel. Create credentials with the scopes you need.

access_notes.value: A free trial store can be signed up for self-serve and API credentials are then created in the store control panel under Settings > API Accounts with the OAuth scopes selected by the developer. Developer sandbox stores are provisioned separately through the BigCommerce Partner Portal (Deal Registration or Partner Use Sandbox). Production plan-tier gating was not verifiable from the fetched pages.
access_notes.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data. Navigate to Settings > API Accounts in your store control panel. Create credentials with the scopes you need.

official_mcp_server.quote: Agents connect to `https://api.bigcommerce.com/mcp`, sign in through the standard BigCommerce login (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE), and then the user chooses which store to connect.

rate_limits.value: Scale: 60k requests/hour (450 per 30 sec); Growth & Core: 20k requests/hour (150 per 30 sec); Performance plans vary by plan and resource; OAuth quotas refresh every 30 seconds and 429 responses expose X-Rate-Limit headers.
rate_limits.quote: | Scale | 60k per hour (450 / 30sec) | | Growth & Core | 20k per hour (150 / 30sec) |

webhooks.quote: This article contains a complete reference of all BigCommerce webhook events and their callback payloads.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Endpoints carry a version segment in the path (/v3/ or /v2/ depending on the current version of the endpoint). The dedicated deprecations and sunsets policy page was not captured in the evidence bundle, so the deprecation window is unconfirmed.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: The API path won’t change, but it will have `/v3/` or `/v2/` appended to it, depending on the current version for the endpoint you’re querying.

verdict_reason: BigCommerce publishes a broad, well-documented REST admin API (catalog, orders, customers, payments, webhooks) plus GraphQL APIs, with downloadable OpenAPI specs. A developer can self-serve a free trial store and create scoped OAuth API credentials directly in the control panel under Settings > API Accounts, with no sales contact or review required for development. Dedicated sandbox stores and webhook event references further reduce integration risk.
open_questions: Official SDK list: the tools-and-sdks page appeared in the search index but its text was not included in the evidence bundle, so vendor-maintained SDK languages could not be confirmed.
Deprecation/sunset policy: the deprecations-sunsets page was not fetched; only the /v2/ and /v3/ URL path convention is evidenced.

Production plan-tier gating: full pricing page text was not part of the SOURCES bundle (only search snippets, which are not valid for quotes), so the paid-plan requirement for live stores is unconfirmed.
Developer sandbox creation requires a BigCommerce Partner Portal account; the exact signup/eligibility steps for that portal were not present in the evidence.
App Marketplace listing/approval requirements were indexed but the approval-requirements page text was not supplied.
No GitHub or MCP registry results were provided, so community MCP servers could not be assessed.
